remarks: Looking for a Private Office?  64 Wall Street offers an ideal downtown location for small businesses. With tall ceilings, exposed brick, and six-foot double-hung windows, this space is perfect for design, media, and other creative industries.  We currently have a 995 SF sublet available for one year, with the possibility of annual renewals. The space features an open floor plan with two private offices and large windows that provide plenty of natural light.  Located on the 4th floor with elevator access, this office is a great opportunity for businesses looking for a stylish and inspiring workspace.
